column6: Tā de Hànyǔ dádào le hěn gāo de shuǐpíng.
column7: His Chinese has reached a high level.

column3: To succeed and "successful": 成功了 "it worked", 取得成功 "achieve success", 成功的经验. The opposite is 失败. 成 "become" + 功 "merit". The reverse of 失败.
column6: Tā zhōngyú chénggōng le.
column7: He finally succeeded.

column3: An "achievement, accomplishment": 取得成就 "achieve something", 很大的成就 "a great accomplishment". 成 "complete" + 就 "accomplish". As a verb it is rare. Used for important, lasting achievements.
column4: 他在科学上取得了很大的成就。
column5: 他在科學上取得了很大的成就。
column6: Tā zài kēxué shang qǔdé le hěn dà de chéngjiù.
column7: He has achieved a great deal in science.

column3: The "fruit, result" of work or research: 研究成果 "research results", 劳动成果 "the fruits of labor". 成 "complete" + 果 "fruit". It is what effort yields, in a positive light.
column6: Zhè shì wǒmen nǔlì de chéngguǒ.
column7: This is the fruit of our efforts.

column3: To overcome a difficulty, habit or problem: 克服困难 "overcome difficulties", 克服缺点 "get over a fault". 克 "conquer" + 服 "subdue". The things overcome are obstacles, not people.
column6: Tā kèfú le hěn duō kùnnan.
column7: He overcame many difficulties.

column3: To solve, resolve: 解决问题 "solve a problem", 解决了 "it's solved". 解 "untie" + 决 "settle". The object is a problem, difficulty or dispute, never a person.
column6: Zhège wèntí jiějué le.
column7: This problem has been solved.

column3: To persist, keep at it: 坚持锻炼 "keep exercising", 坚持下去 "keep going". 坚 "firm" + 持 "hold". Often with 每天 "every day", as in making a habit. It can also mean to insist: 坚持己见.
column6: Tā měitiān jiānchí pǎobù.
column7: He keeps running every day.

column3: To confirm, fix, determine: 确定时间 "fix a time", 还没确定 "not decided yet". As an adjective, "sure, definite": 我不确定 "I'm not sure". 确 "certain" + 定 "settle".
column6: Shíjiān hái méi quèdìng.
column7: The time has not been fixed yet.

column3: Accurate, exact: 你说得很准 "you said it right", 准时 "on time", 准确 "accurate". The simplified 准 stands for 準 "accurate" and also for the older 准 "to allow": 准许 "permit". In traditional text they are two characters.
column6: Nǐ de fāyīn hěn zhǔn.
column7: Your pronunciation is very accurate.

column3: Fate, destiny: 改变命运 "change one's fate", 命运不好 "bad luck in life". 命 "life, fate" + 运 "luck". It is about the course a life takes. Said of people, countries and objects with a history.
column4: 你可以改变自己的命运。
column5: 你可以改變自己的命運。
column6: Nǐ kěyǐ gǎibiàn zìjǐ de mìngyùn.
column7: You can change your own fate.

column3: Confidence, certainty as a noun: 有把握 "be confident", 没把握 "not sure". As a verb, "to grasp, seize": 把握机会 "seize the opportunity". 把 and 握 both mean "hold".
column6: Wǒ yǒu bǎwò tōngguò kǎoshì.
column7: I'm confident I'll pass the exam.

column3: Skill, ability that someone has learned: 学本领 "learn skills", 有本领 "capable". 本 "root" + 领 "ability". Said of people or animals, often hard-earned skills. Slightly formal compared to 本事.
column6: Tā xué dào le yī shēn běnlǐng.
column7: He has learned a full set of skills.

column3: Ability, skill in speech: 有本事 "capable", 没本事 "incompetent". The second syllable is neutral. Often spoken with a bit of challenge: 有本事你来 "if you've got the guts, come".
column6: Tā hěn yǒu běnshi.
column7: He is very capable.

column3: Talent, ability: 音乐才能 "musical talent", 发挥才能 "make use of one's talents". 才 "talent" + 能 "ability". The same two characters are also an adverb pair "only then can", as in 只有努力才能成功.
column6: Tā yǒu yīnyuè cáinéng.
column7: He has musical talent.

column3: Ability, capacity: 工作能力 "work ability", 有能力 "capable", 语言能力 "language ability". 能 "can" + 力 "strength". It can be learned or natural. It is broader than 本事 and used in formal or neutral writing.
column6: Tā de gōngzuò nénglì hěn qiáng.
column7: Her ability at work is strong.

column3: Can or cannot? The yes-no question built from 能: 你能不能帮我？ is the same as 你能帮我吗？ but sounds more direct and asks for a real answer. The 不 in the middle is neutral.
column6: Nǐ néngbunéng bāng wǒ yīxià?
column7: Can you help me a bit?

column3: Strength, force: 力气 "physical strength", 努力 "make an effort", 能力 "ability", 压力 "pressure". On its own it is a bound form, found inside compounds. In speech, 劲 and 力气 are often used.
column6: Tā lìqi hěn dà.
column7: He is very strong.

column3: Strength, power, force: 团结就是力量 "unity is strength", 人民的力量 "the people's power". 力 "strength" + 量 "amount". Used for both physical force and moral or collective strength. The second syllable is neutral.
column6: Tuánjié jiùshì lìliang.
column7: Unity is strength.

column3: Driving force, motivation, power: 学习动力 "motivation to study", 汽车动力 "engine power". 动 "move" + 力 "force". Both a machine's power and a person's drive.
column6: Xuéxí xūyào dònglì.
column7: Studying needs motivation.

column3: Real strength, capability: 有实力 "strong, capable", 经济实力 "economic strength". 实 "real" + 力 "strength". The strength is proved by ability, as in a team or a company.
column6: Zhè zhī qiúduì hěn yǒu shílì.
column7: This team is really strong.

column3: Function, feature of a device or a part: 手机的功能 "phone functions", 多功能 "multifunctional". 功 "effect" + 能 "ability". What something can do. It is not the "function" of mathematics.
column6: Zhège shǒujī yǒu hěn duō gōngnéng.
column7: This phone has many functions.

column3: Kung fu, Chinese martial arts: 会功夫 "know kung fu". It also means "skill gained through hard practice": 下功夫 "put in effort". The second syllable is neutral. It is also sometimes written for 工夫 "time".
column6: Tā huì Zhōngguó gōngfu.
column7: He knows Chinese kung fu.

column3: Time, free time and "effort": 没工夫 "have no time", 花工夫 "spend effort", 有工夫再说 "let's talk when there's time". The second syllable is neutral. It sounds the same as 功夫 but the meaning is time or labor.
column6: Wǒ jīntiān méiyǒu gōngfu.
column7: I don't have time today.

column3: To press, to weigh down: 压坏 "crush", 压力 "pressure", 压低 "press down, lower". 压 is also in 高压 and 血压 "blood pressure". It describes a heavy object pressing on something.
column6: Qǐng bùyào yā huài huā.
column7: Please don't crush the flowers.

column3: Pressure, stress: 工作压力 "work pressure", 压力大 "under a lot of pressure", 减轻压力 "relieve stress". It covers both physical pressure and mental strain. 压 "press" + 力 "force".
column6: Tā de gōngzuò yālì hěn dà.
column7: He is under a lot of pressure at work.

column3: Strong: 身体强 "physically strong", 能力强 "capable", 强大 "powerful". Also used for "better than", 他比我强 "he is better than me". There are two other readings, qiǎng (force) and jiàng (stubborn), in other words.
column6: Zhè zhī duìwu hěn qiáng.
column7: This team is very strong.

column3: Powerful, strong for a country, an army, a company: 强大的国家 "a powerful country", 越来越强大 "getting stronger and stronger". 强 "strong" + 大 "big". For a person's body, use 强壮.
column6: Zhège guójiā yuèláiyuè qiángdà.
column7: This country is getting stronger and stronger.

column3: Intense, strong about feelings, light, wishes and reactions: 强烈的感觉 "a strong feeling", 强烈要求 "demand strongly". 强 "strong" + 烈 "fierce". Not for physical strength.
column6: Wǒ yǒu yī zhǒng qiángliè de gǎnjué.
column7: I have a strong feeling.

column3: To strengthen, step up: 加强锻炼 "do more exercise", 加强合作 "strengthen cooperation". 加 "add" + 强 "strong". The object is an action or a relationship, not a thing that is physically weak.
column6: Wǒmen yào jiāqiáng duànliàn.
column7: We need to exercise more.

column3: To make, build: 造房子 "build a house", 造句 "make a sentence", 造船 "build ships". It is the physical making of larger things. Common in compounds like 创造, 制造 and 造成.
column6: Gōngrén zài zào fángzi.
column7: The workers are building a house.

column3: To cause, bring about, mostly with bad results: 造成损失 "cause losses", 造成事故 "cause an accident". 造 "make" + 成 "become". The subject is an event or fact, and the object is the result.
column6: Dàyǔ zàochéng le jiāotōng wèntí.
column7: The heavy rain caused traffic problems.

column3: To create something new: 创造机会 "create opportunities", 创造财富 "create wealth". 创 "begin" + 造 "make". Wider than 创作, which is for art, and it can include abstract things.
column6: Rénmen chuàngzào le xīn de shēnghuó.
column7: People have created a new life.

column3: To innovate and "innovation": 技术创新 "technical innovation", 勇于创新 "bold in innovating". 创 "begin" + 新 "new". A key word in business and policy.
column6: Gōngsī xūyào chuàngxīn.
column7: The company needs innovation.

column3: To invent and "invention": 发明电话 "invent the telephone", 一项发明 "an invention". 发 "bring out" + 明 "bright, clear". It means something new that did not exist, not just a discovery (that is 发现).
column6: Zhǐ shì Zhōngguórén fāmíng de.
column7: Paper was invented by the Chinese.

column3: To manufacture: 制造汽车 "make cars", 制造业 "manufacturing industry", 制造麻烦 "make trouble". 制 "make" + 造 "build". Industrial making, also used for making situations: 制造机会.
column6: Zhège gōngchǎng zhìzào qìchē.
column7: This factory makes cars.

column3: To make, produce, for things made with skill: 制作视频 "make a video", 制作蛋糕 "make a cake", 制作人 "producer". 制 "make" + 作 "make". More skill-based and smaller scale than 制造.
column6: Tā zài zhìzuò yī bù diànyǐng.
column7: He is making a film.

column3: To produce, manufacture: 生产手机 "make phones", 生产线 "production line". 生 "give birth" + 产 "produce". Also used for farming output and, in a medical setting, giving birth.
column6: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng shēngchǎn shǒujī.
column7: This factory produces mobile phones.

column3: To design and "design": 设计房子 "design a house", 服装设计 "fashion design", 设计师 "designer". 设 "set up" + 计 "plan". It is both the plan and the profession.
column6: Zhè dòng fángzi shì tā shèjì de.
column7: This house was designed by him.

column3: Equipment, facilities: 医疗设备 "medical equipment", 设备齐全 "fully equipped". 设 "set up" + 备 "prepare". It is a mass noun for machines and installations in a place; the measure word is 套.
column6: Zhèlǐ de shèbèi hěn xīn.
column7: The equipment here is very new.

column3: Machine: 机器人 "robot", 洗衣机 "washing machine" (the shortened form 机 is common). 机 "machine" + 器 "device". Measure word 台. It sounds more technical than 机.
column6: Zhè tái jīqì huài le.
column7: This machine is broken.

column3: Tool: 工具箱 "toolbox", 交通工具 "means of transport", 学习工具 "study tool". 工 "work" + 具 "instrument". It also describes anything that helps do a job, including software.
column6: Wǒ xūyào yīxiē gōngjù.
column7: I need some tools.

column3: To build, establish: 建房子 "build a house", 建桥 "build a bridge", 建议 "suggest", 建立 "establish". Mostly with big projects. The simple 建 is also used for forming organizations.
column4: 他们在山上建了一座房子。
column5: 他們在山上建了一座房子。
column6: Tāmen zài shān shang jiàn le yī zuò fángzi.
column7: They built a house on the mountain.

column3: To be built, completed: 建成通车 "built and opened to traffic", 已经建成 "already finished". 建 "build" + 成, the result complement "complete". Used for large projects such as bridges and roads.
column6: Zhè zuò qiáo qùnián jiànchéng le.
column7: This bridge was completed last year.

column3: To establish, set up: 建立关系 "build a relationship", 建立公司 "found a company", 建立信任 "build trust". 建 "build" + 立 "stand". Used with abstract things, such as relationships, systems and trust.
column4: 我们建立了很好的关系。
column5: 我們建立了很好的關係。
column6: Wǒmen jiànlì le hěn hǎo de guānxi.
column7: We built a good relationship.

column3: To build, construction: 经济建设 "economic development", 城市建设 "urban development". 建 "build" + 设 "set up". Used for big, systematic building of cities, countries and institutions.
column4: 这个城市正在大力建设。
column5: 這個城市正在大力建設。
column6: Zhège chéngshì zhèngzài dàlì jiànshè.
column7: This city is being built up with great effort.

column3: To set up, establish an organization, office or program: 设立办公室 "set up an office", 设立奖学金 "establish a scholarship". 设 "set up" + 立 "stand". More formal than 建立, for institutions.
column4: 学校设立了一个新专业。
column5: 學校設立了一個新專業。
column6: Xuéxiào shèlì le yī gè xīn zhuānyè.
column7: The school has set up a new program.

column3: To be founded, to come into being: 公司成立 "the company was founded", 成立于…… "founded in". 成 "become" + 立 "stand". The subject is the organization, which is different from 设立 where somebody sets it up.
column4: 这家公司成立于十年前。
column5: 這家公司成立於十年前。
column6: Zhè jiā gōngsī chénglì yú shí nián qián.
column7: This company was founded ten years ago.

column3: To form, take shape: 形成习惯 "form a habit", 形成风格 "develop a style". The subject takes shape gradually. 形 "shape" + 成 "become". For things that arise through a process, rather than a person's act.
column6: Hǎo xíguàn xūyào shíjiān xíngchéng.
column7: Good habits take time to form.

column3: To produce, give rise to, arise: 产生影响 "have an influence", 产生问题 "problems arise", 产生兴趣 "become interested". 产 "produce" + 生 "arise". The subject is the cause or the situation, and the object a result that appears.
column4: 这件事产生了很大的影响。
column5: 這件事產生了很大的影響。
column6: Zhè jiàn shì chǎnshēng le hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
column7: This event had a great influence.

column3: To use, make use of, or "to take advantage of": 利用时间 "make use of time", 利用别人 "exploit others". 利 "benefit" + 用 "use". The meaning is positive with things and negative with people.
column6: Yào hǎohāo lìyòng shíjiān.
column7: You should make good use of your time.

column3: To apply, use and "application": 应用技术 "apply technology", 应用程序 or 应用 "app", 广泛应用 "widely used". 应 "respond to" + 用 "use". Often seen on phones as the word for "app".
column6: Zhè zhǒng jìshù yìngyòng hěn guǎng.
column7: This technology is widely used.

column3: To be applicable, suitable for use: 适用于所有人 "applies to everyone", 适用范围 "scope of application". 适 "suit" + 用 "use". Used for rules, methods and products and what they cover.
column4: 这个规定适用于所有人。
column5: 這個規定適用於所有人。
column6: Zhège guīdìng shìyòng yú suǒyǒu rén.
column7: This rule applies to everyone.

column3: To adopt, use: 采用新方法 "adopt a new method", 采用意见 "accept a suggestion". 采 "pick, choose" + 用 "use". The user chooses among options and decides to go with one.
column6: Xuéxiào cǎiyòng le xīn de jiàocái.
column7: The school adopted new teaching materials.

column3: To take, adopt a measure or attitude: 采取措施 "take measures", 采取行动 "take action", 采取态度 "take an attitude". 采 "pick" + 取 "take". Used with abstract objects, not physical things.
column6: Wǒmen yào cǎiqǔ xíngdòng.
column7: We have to take action.

column3: Useless: 这个没用 "this is no use", 说了也没用 "no use even saying it". 没 "not have" + 用 "use". Also describes a person: 他很没用, which is harsh. For "no need", say 不用.
column6: Zhège bànfǎ méiyòng.
column7: This method is useless.

column3: To engage in, be occupied in a field of work: 从事教育工作 "work in education", 从事研究 "do research". 从 "follow" + 事 "affair". A formal way to say what field you work in.
column6: Tā cóngshì jiàoyù gōngzuò.
column7: He works in education.

column3: To handle, deal with, process: 处理问题 "deal with a problem", 处理文件 "process documents". 处 "deal with" + 理 "manage". The object is a matter that needs a decision. The reading of 处 is chǔ.
column6: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ lái chǔlǐ.
column7: I'll handle this.

column3: To arrange, schedule: 安排时间 "arrange time", 安排工作 "assign work", 日程安排 "schedule". Also a noun: 这样的安排很好. 安 "settle" + 排 "arrange". It means planning in an orderly way.
column6: Wǒ lái ānpái shíjiān.
column7: I'll arrange the time.

column3: To carry out, put into practice: 实行新制度 "adopt a new system", 实行计划 "carry out a plan". 实 "real" + 行 "do". The subject is usually an organization, and the object is a policy or system.
column6: Gōngsī shíxíng xīn de zhìdù.
column7: The company is putting a new system into practice.

column3: To suit, be suitable for: 适合你 "suits you", 适合孩子看 "suitable for children". 适 "fit" + 合 "match". It takes a person or group as object: 这件衣服适合你.
column6: Zhè jiàn yīfu shìhé nǐ.
column7: This piece of clothing suits you.

column3: To adapt to: 适应环境 "adapt to the environment", 适应新生活 "get used to a new life". 适 "fit" + 应 "respond". The person changes to fit the situation, which is where it differs from 习惯.
column6: Tā hěn kuài shìyìng le xīn huánjìng.
column7: He quickly adapted to the new environment.

column3: To protect, keep, guarantee: 保护 "protect", 保证 "guarantee", 保险 "insurance", 保温 "keep warm". It is a bound form found in compounds, with the idea of keeping something safe.
column6: Zhège bēizi kěyǐ bǎowēn.
column7: This cup keeps drinks warm.

column3: To protect: 保护环境 "protect the environment", 保护眼睛 "protect your eyes", 保护动物 "protect animals". 保 "protect" + 护 "guard". The object is something vulnerable, and the action is deliberate.
column6: Wǒmen yào bǎohù huánjìng.
column7: We must protect the environment.

column3: To keep, maintain a state: 保持安静 "keep quiet", 保持联系 "stay in touch", 保持健康 "stay healthy". 保 "keep" + 持 "hold". The thing kept is a state that already exists or is wanted.
column6: Qǐng bǎochí ānjìng.
column7: Please keep quiet.

column3: Insurance: 买保险 "buy insurance", 汽车保险 "car insurance". As an adjective, "safe, sure": 这样比较保险 "this is safer". 保 "protect" + 险 "danger".
column6: Tā mǎi le qìchē bǎoxiǎn.
column7: He bought car insurance.

column3: To guarantee, promise: 我保证 "I promise", 质量保证 "quality guarantee". 保 "guarantee" + 证 "prove". It is a firm promise, stronger than 答应, and can also be a noun.
column6: Wǒ bǎozhèng míngtiān yīdìng dào.
column7: I promise I'll arrive tomorrow.

column3: To ensure, make sure: 确保安全 "ensure safety", 确保质量 "ensure quality". 确 "certain" + 保 "protect". The one who ensures does something so that the result is certain. Formal.
column6: Wǒmen yào quèbǎo ānquán.
column7: We must ensure safety.

column3: To guard against, prevent: 防火 "fire prevention", 防晒 "sun protection", 预防 "prevent", 防止 "prevent". In speech, 防 + noun states what is guarded against. It is mostly a bound form.
column6: Xiàtiān yào fáng shài.
column7: In summer you need sun protection.

column3: To prevent, guard against: 防止事故 "prevent accidents", 防止错误 "avoid mistakes". 防 "guard" + 止 "stop". The object is something unwanted, and the action comes before it can happen.
column6: Yào fángzhǐ xiǎohái shòushāng.
column7: You must prevent children from getting hurt.

column3: To prevent ahead of time: 预防感冒 "prevent colds", 预防疾病 "prevent disease". 预 "in advance" + 防 "guard". Common in health. It is what you do before something starts.
column6: Duō xǐshǒu kěyǐ yùfáng gǎnmào.
column7: Washing your hands often can prevent colds.

column3: To forecast and "forecast": 天气预报 "weather forecast", 预报明天有雨. 预 "in advance" + 报 "report". Mostly for weather, but also used for earthquakes and tides.
column6: Tiānqì yùbào shuō míngtiān yǒu yǔ.
column7: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.

column3: To estimate, expect, project: 预计明天下雨 "rain is expected tomorrow", 预计成本 "estimated cost". 预 "in advance" + 计 "count". A calculated guess about the future.
column6: Yùjì míngtiān huì xià yǔ.
column7: Rain is expected tomorrow.

column3: To endanger, harm and "harm": 危害健康 "harm health", 危害很大 "does great harm". 危 "danger" + 害 "harm". The subject is something that hurts, such as smoking or pollution.
column6: Chōuyān wēihài jiànkāng.
column7: Smoking harms your health.

column3: Dangerous, danger: 很危险 "very dangerous", 有危险 "there is danger", 脱离危险 "out of danger". 危 "dangerous" + 险 "risk". Warnings often say 危险！ for "Danger!"
column6: Zhèlǐ hěn wēixiǎn.
column7: It is dangerous here.

column3: Risk: 有风险 "carry risk", 冒风险 "take a risk", 风险大 "high risk". 风 "wind" + 险 "danger". In business and finance, 投资有风险 is a standard phrase.
column6: Tóuzī yǒu fēngxiǎn.
column7: Investing carries risk.

column3: An "accident" such as a crash, a factory accident or a mishap: 交通事故 "traffic accident", 发生事故 "an accident happens". 事 "affair" + 故 "cause". Typically used for accidents with injury or loss.
column6: Lù shang fāshēng le yī qǐ shìgù.
column7: An accident happened on the road.

column3: Unexpected, and "accident": 意外的消息 "unexpected news", 意外事故 "accident", 真意外 "what a surprise". 意 "expectation" + 外 "outside", beyond what was expected. Used for both surprises and mishaps.
column6: Zhè zhēn shì ge yìwài.
column7: This is truly a surprise.

column3: Troublesome and "trouble": 惹麻烦 "cause trouble", 很麻烦 "such a hassle". As a verb, polite "to trouble someone": 麻烦你…… "could I trouble you to…", used when you ask for a favor.
column6: Máfan nǐ bāng wǒ ná yīxià.
column7: Could you please hold this for me?

column3: A "fault, defect" in a machine or habit, or a "minor illness": 出毛病 "go wrong", 老毛病 "old problem, chronic trouble", 有毛病 "something wrong". Often casual: 你有毛病吗？ is rude, meaning "are you crazy?".
column6: Wǒ de diànnǎo chū máobìng le.
column7: Something is wrong with my computer.

column3: Mistake, error: 犯错误 "make a mistake", 严重的错误 "a serious mistake". Also an adjective: 错误的想法 "a wrong idea". 错 and 误 both mean "wrong". More formal than 错.
column6: Zhè shì yī gè yánzhòng de cuòwù.
column7: This is a serious mistake.

column3: Messy, disorderly, chaotic: 房间很乱 "the room is a mess", 乱写 "scribble", 乱说 "talk nonsense". As an adverb, it means "without order, at random": 别乱跑.
column6: Tā de fángjiān hěn luàn.
column7: His room is a mess.

column3: A "system" of rules and institutions: 公司制度 "company rules", 教育制度 "education system", 社会制度 "social system". 制 "regulate" + 度 "standard". It is a set of rules that people must follow, bigger than a single 规定.
column6: Gōngsī yǒu yángé de zhìdù.
column7: The company has strict rules.

column3: To draw up, formulate a plan, law or rule: 制定计划 "draw up a plan", 制定法律 "make a law". 制 "make" + 定 "set". The object is a document or policy, and the one who draws it up is in charge.
column6: Xuéxiào zhìdìng le xīn de guīdìng.
column7: The school drew up new rules.

column3: To stipulate and "regulation": 学校规定不能带手机 "the school rules say no phones", 按照规定 "according to the rules". 规 "rule" + 定 "fix". It is the rule itself and the act of setting it.
column6: Xuéxiào guīdìng bù néng dài shǒujī.
column7: The school rules do not allow phones.

column3: A "standard, norm" and "standardized": 行为规范 "code of conduct", 不规范 "not standard". 规 "rule" + 范 "model". As a verb it means to standardize: 规范市场. Often used for writing, speech and behavior.
column6: Zhèyàng xiě bù guīfàn.
column7: Writing it this way is not standard.

column3: Standard, criterion: 国家标准 "national standard", 标准答案 "standard answer", 达到标准 "meet the standard". As an adjective, "standard, proper": 发音很标准 "pronunciation is very accurate". 准 here is read zhǔn.
column6: Zhège biāozhǔn tài gāo le.
column7: This standard is too high.

column3: To approve, grant permission: 批准申请 "approve an application", 得到批准 "get approval". 批 "approve" + 准 "allow". Said by a superior or authority, not by a friend.
column6: Jīnglǐ pīzhǔn le tā de qǐngjià.
column7: The manager approved his leave.

column3: Formalities, procedures: 办手续 "go through the formalities", 入学手续 "enrollment procedures", 手续费 "handling fee". 手 "hand" + 续 "continue". It is the set of steps and papers for official business.
column6: Bàn qiānzhèng de shǒuxù hěn fùzá.
column7: The procedure for getting a visa is complicated.

column3: To handle, process official business: 办理手续 "go through the procedure", 办理入住 "check in". 办 "do" + 理 "manage". A formal word, used by staff and on signs, with an object such as a procedure.
column6: Qǐng dào zhèlǐ bànlǐ shǒuxù.
column7: Please go through the formalities here.

column3: To be in charge of, manage and "to care about, interfere": 管孩子 "look after the children", 别管我 "leave me alone", 谁管这件事？ "who is in charge of this?". In speech it is blunt. 不管 means "no matter".
column6: Nǐ bié guǎn wǒ.
column7: Leave me alone.

column3: To manage, run people, a shop or a system: 管理公司 "manage a company", 管理员 "administrator", 时间管理 "time management". 管 "be in charge" + 理 "manage". Also a noun.
column6: Tā fùzé guǎnlǐ zhè jiā shāngdiàn.
column7: He is in charge of running this store.

column3: To be responsible for, in charge: 负责这个项目 "be in charge of this project", 对……负责 "be responsible to". Also an adjective: 他很负责 "he is responsible". 负 "bear" + 责 "duty".
column6: Zhè jiàn shì yóu shéi fùzé?
column7: Who is in charge of this?

column3: Responsibility, duty, blame: 负责任 "be responsible", 有责任 "have a duty", 这是我的责任 "this is my fault". 责 "duty" + 任 "task". Can mean either duty or blame, depending on the sentence.
column6: Zhè shì wǒ de zérèn.
column7: This is my responsibility.

column3: To take a post, to appoint: 任经理 "serve as manager", 担任 "take on a role", 任务 "task". It also appears in 任何 "any" and 信任 "trust". As a verb on its own it is formal.
column6: Tā rèn jīnglǐ yǐjīng sān nián le.
column7: He has been the manager for three years.

column3: To send, assign a person to a task or place: 派人 "send someone", 派他去 "send him". 派 is also a "school, faction": 学派. The sender is a superior.
column6: Gōngsī pài tā qù Shànghǎi.
column7: The company is sending him to Shanghai.

column3: To lead, and "to receive, collect" something you are entitled to: 领工资 "receive wages", 领包裹 "pick up a parcel", 领奖 "receive a prize". It is also the neck or collar: 领带 "tie".
column6: Wǒ qù lǐng bāoguǒ.
column7: I'm going to pick up the parcel.

column3: To lead a group: 带领大家 "lead everyone", 在……带领下 "under the leadership of". 带 "bring" + 领 "lead". The person leads the group to a place or a goal. A more formal word than 带.
column4: 老师带领学生参观博物馆。
column5: 老師帶領學生參觀博物館。
column6: Lǎoshī dàilǐng xuésheng cānguān bówùguǎn.
column7: The teacher led the students on a visit to the museum.

column3: To drive, spur on, bring along: 带动经济 "drive the economy", 带动大家 "get everyone moving". 带 "bring" + 动 "move". One thing sets others in motion by its example or effect.
column4: 他带动了大家一起努力。
column5: 他帶動了大家一起努力。
column6: Tā dàidòng le dàjiā yīqǐ nǔlì.
column7: He got everyone to work hard together.

column3: To host, preside over: 主持会议 "chair a meeting", 主持人 "host, MC". 主 "lead" + 持 "hold". The person who runs a meeting, show or ceremony. Also "to take charge of".
column6: Tā zhǔchí zhè cì huìyì.
column7: He chairs this meeting.

column3: To push forward, promote: 推动发展 "promote development", 推动改革 "push reform". 推 "push" + 动 "move". The object is a process or a cause. The literal sense is moving something by pushing.
column4: 这个项目推动了经济发展。
column5: 這個項目推動了經濟發展。
column6: Zhège xiàngmù tuīdòng le jīngjì fāzhǎn.
column7: This project boosted economic development.

column3: To promote, spread widely: 推广产品 "promote a product", 推广普通话 "promote Putonghua". 推 "push" + 广 "wide". It makes a product, method or idea known and used by many.
column6: Wǒmen zài tuīguǎng zhège chǎnpǐn.
column7: We are promoting this product.

column3: To push forward, advance a project or process: 推进工作 "move the work forward", 稳步推进 "advance steadily". 推 "push" + 进 "advance". Used of ongoing programs, in formal speech.
column6: Gōngzuò zhèngzài wěnbù tuījìn.
column7: The work is advancing steadily.

column3: Society: 社会问题 "social problem", 进入社会 "enter society, start work life", 社会生活. 社 "group" + 会 "meeting". Used for the community as a whole and for the world outside school.
column6: Shèhuì zài bùduàn fāzhǎn.
column7: Society keeps developing.

column3: Culture: 中国文化 "Chinese culture", 文化差异 "cultural differences", 文化水平 "level of education". 文 "writing" + 化 "transform". It covers customs, arts and education.
column4: 我喜欢了解不同的文化。
column5: 我喜歡了解不同的文化。
column6: Wǒ xǐhuan liǎojiě bùtóng de wénhuà.
column7: I like learning about different cultures.

column3: Civilization and "civilized, polite": 中华文明 "Chinese civilization", 文明礼貌 "civilized manners". 文 "culture" + 明 "bright". It is also a slogan word for good public behavior.
column6: Zhōngguó yǒu wǔqiān nián de wénmíng.
column7: China has five thousand years of civilization.

column3: Peace: 世界和平 "world peace", 和平共处 "peaceful coexistence", 和平的生活 "a peaceful life". 和 "harmony" + 平 "calm". It refers to the absence of war, not inner calm (that is 平静).
column6: Dàjiā dōu xīwàng shìjiè hépíng.
column7: Everyone hopes for world peace.

column3: World: 全世界 "the whole world", 世界上 "in the world", 世界各地 "all around the world". 世 "age, generation" + 界 "boundary". Used both for the planet and for a sphere: 动物世界 "the animal world".
column6: Zhè shì shìjiè shang zuì gāo de shān.
column7: This is the highest mountain in the world.

column3: Diplomacy, foreign affairs: 外交部 "Ministry of Foreign Affairs", 外交官 "diplomat", 外交政策 "foreign policy". 外 "outside" + 交 "relations". It is the contact between states.
column6: Tā zài wàijiāobù gōngzuò.
column7: He works at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

column3: To unite, join and "joint": 联合起来 "unite", 联合举办 "jointly organize", 联合声明 "joint statement". 联 "connect" + 合 "combine". The subjects are usually organizations or countries.
column4: 两家公司联合举办了这次活动。
column5: 兩家公司聯合舉辦了這次活動。
column6: Liǎng jiā gōngsī liánhé jǔbàn le zhè cì huódòng.
column7: The two companies organized this event together.

column3: The "United Nations": 联合 "united" + 国 "nations". The UN is also called 联合国 in headlines and news; its staff are 联合国官员.
column6: Liánhéguó zǒngbù zài Niǔyuē.
column7: The United Nations headquarters is in New York.

column3: Public: 公共汽车 "bus", 公共场所 "public place", 公共交通 "public transport". 公 "public" + 共 "shared". It describes spaces and services for everyone. The second 共 is fourth tone.
column4: 请不要在公共场所大声说话。
column5: 請不要在公共場所大聲說話。
column6: Qǐng bùyào zài gōnggòng chǎngsuǒ dàshēng shuōhuà.
column7: Please do not talk loudly in public places.

column3: Public, open and "to make public": 公开信息 "make information public", 公开课 "open lecture", 公开道歉 "apologize publicly". 公 "public" + 开 "open". The opposite of secret.
column6: Zhège xiāoxi hái méiyǒu gōngkāi.
column7: This news has not been made public yet.

column3: To unite and "united": 团结一致 "united as one", 团结就是力量 "unity is strength". 团 "group" + 结 "tie". Often used in slogans. The opposite is 分裂.
column6: Dàjiā yào tuánjié.
column7: We all have to stay united.

column3: A "group, organization": 社会团体 "social group", 团体活动 "group activity", 团体票 "group ticket". 团 "group" + 体 "body". It has members and a shared aim, such as a club.
column4: 他参加了一个志愿者团体。
column5: 他參加了一個志願者團體。
column6: Tā cānjiā le yī gè zhìyuànzhě tuántǐ.
column7: He joined a volunteer group.

column3: Collective, group: 集体活动 "group activity", 集体宿舍 "dormitory", 集体利益 "collective interest". The opposite is 个人. 集 "gather" + 体 "body". Stresses the unit that acts together.
column6: Zhè shì jítǐ huódòng.
column7: This is a group activity.

column3: To concentrate, focus, gather: 集中注意力 "focus attention", 集中精力 "focus energy", 集中在一起 "gather together". 集 "gather" + 中 "center". The object can be attention or things.
column6: Shàngkè yào jízhōng zhùyìlì.
column7: You have to focus in class.

column3: To represent and "representative": 代表学校 "represent the school", 代表大家 "speak for everyone", 学生代表 "student representative". 代 "on behalf of" + 表 "show". It can also mean "to stand for": 红色代表喜庆.
column6: Tā dàibiǎo xuéxiào cānjiā bǐsài.
column7: He represents the school in the competition.

column3: A "delegation": 代表 "representative" + 团 "group". 访问代表团 "visiting delegation", 中国代表团 "the Chinese delegation". It is a group sent by an organization or country.
column6: Dàibiǎotuán míngtiān dào Běijīng.
column7: The delegation arrives in Beijing tomorrow.

column3: Meeting, conference: 开会议 or 开会 "hold a meeting", 会议室 "meeting room", 会议结束 "the meeting is over". 会 "meet" + 议 "discuss". More formal than 会.
column6: Huìyì xiàwǔ sān diǎn kāishǐ.
column7: The meeting starts at three in the afternoon.

column3: To cooperate and "cooperation": 合作愉快 "pleasant cooperation", 和他合作 "work with him". 合 "join" + 作 "work". Common in business, where the two sides work toward a common aim.
column4: 我们两家公司合作得很好。
column5: 我們兩家公司合作得很好。
column6: Wǒmen liǎng jiā gōngsī hézuò de hěn hǎo.
column7: Our two companies cooperate very well.

column3: To coordinate with, cooperate: 配合工作 "cooperate with the work", 请配合 "please cooperate". 配 "match" + 合 "fit". One side adjusts to help the other, as when asked by staff or police.
column4: 请大家配合我们的工作。
column5: 請大家配合我們的工作。
column6: Qǐng dàjiā pèihé wǒmen de gōngzuò.
column7: Please cooperate with our work, everyone.

column3: Environment, surroundings: 自然环境 "natural environment", 学习环境 "study environment", 保护环境 "protect the environment". 环 "surround" + 境 "area". It is both the physical setting and the conditions around you.
column6: Zhèlǐ de huánjìng hěn hǎo.
column7: The environment here is very good.

column3: Environmental protection and "eco-friendly": 环保袋 "reusable bag", 很环保 "very eco-friendly". It is a short form of 环境保护. In speech it works as an adjective too.
column6: Tāmen hěn zhòngshì huánbǎo.
column7: They take environmental protection seriously.

column3: A "ring, loop": 耳环 "earring", 手环 "bracelet", 环形 "ring-shaped". As a verb, "to surround": 环绕. It is also in 环境 and 环保. Beijing's ring roads are numbered, as in 二环 "Second Ring".
column6: Tā dài zhe yī duì ěrhuán.
column7: She is wearing a pair of earrings.

column3: Nature, "natural" and "naturally": 大自然 "nature", 很自然 "very natural", 自然会好 "it will get better naturally". 自 "self" + 然 "so". As an adverb, "of course".
column6: Wǒ xǐhuan qīnjìn zìrán.
column7: I like being close to nature.

column3: Independent, autonomous: 自主学习 "independent study", 自主选择 "choose freely". 自 "self" + 主 "lead". Used when someone decides for themselves instead of being told.
column6: Tā xǐhuan zìzhǔ xuéxí.
column7: He likes to study independently.

column3: To support: 支持你 "support you", 谢谢你的支持 "thanks for your support", 支持这个想法 "back this idea". 支 "prop" + 持 "hold". It includes moral and material support, and agreement. Also "support" as a noun.
column6: Xièxie nǐ yīzhí zhīchí wǒ.
column7: Thank you for always supporting me.

column3: Respectively, separately: 他们分别来自…… "they come from … respectively". Also "to part": 分别多年 "apart for years", and "to distinguish": 分别好坏. 分 "divide" + 别 "separate". The "respectively" use is the most common at this level.
column4: 他们分别来自北京和上海。
column5: 他們分別來自北京和上海。
column6: Tāmen fēnbié láizì Běijīng hé Shànghǎi.
column7: They come from Beijing and Shanghai respectively.

column3: To distribute, assign: 分配任务 "assign tasks", 分配工作 "allocate work", 合理分配 "distribute fairly". 分 "divide" + 配 "match". The person in charge gives each a share or a task.
column4: 老师给每个人分配了任务。
column5: 老師給每個人分配了任務。
column6: Lǎoshī gěi měi gè rén fēnpèi le rènwu.
column7: The teacher assigned a task to each person.

column3: To divide into groups: 分组讨论 "discuss in groups", 分组练习 "practice in groups". 分 "divide" + 组 "group". Used in class and training.
column6: Wǒmen fēnzǔ tǎolùn ba.
column7: Let's split into groups and discuss.

column3: Difference and "to distinguish": 有什么区别？ "what's the difference?", 区别对待 "treat differently". 区 "divide" + 别 "separate". The question 有什么区别 is the useful phrase for comparing two words.
column6: Zhè liǎng gè cí yǒu shénme qūbié?
column7: What is the difference between these two words?

column3: Kind, category: 这类书 "this kind of book", 分类 "classify", 人类 "mankind", 种类 "kinds". As a measure word: 一类 "one kind". Placed before the noun it groups.
column6: Zhè lèi shū hěn shòu huānyíng.
column7: This kind of book is very popular.

column3: Similar, like: 类似的问题 "a similar problem", 类似于…… "similar to…". 类 "kind" + 似 "alike". Used when things are of the same kind, not identical.
column4: 我也遇到过类似的问题。
column5: 我也遇到過類似的問題。
column6: Wǒ yě yùdào guo lèisì de wèntí.
column7: I have run into a similar problem too.

column3: Similar, alike: 长得相似 "look alike", 相似的地方 "similarities". 相 "mutual" + 似 "resemble". Describes two things or people that resemble each other. Here 似 is read sì, but in 似的 it is shì.
column6: Zhè liǎng gè rén zhǎng de hěn xiāngsì.
column7: These two people look very alike.

column3: Related, relevant: 相关的资料 "relevant material", 和……相关 "related to". 相 "mutual" + 关 "connect". Used for topics and facts, and often found in formal writing and news.
column6: Zhè hé wǒmen de gōngzuò xiāngguān.
column7: This is related to our work.

column3: Compared with: 和……相比 "compared with…", 相比之下 "by comparison". 相 "mutual" + 比 "compare". It usually opens a sentence and then states the difference.
column4: 和去年相比，今年冷多了。
column5: 和去年相比，今年冷多了。
column6: Hé qùnián xiāngbǐ, jīnnián lěng duō le.
column7: Compared with last year, this year is much colder.

column3: To belong to, and "to be born in the year of" an animal: 我属马 "I was born in the year of the horse". It is also in 属于 "belong to" and 金属 "metal". The question is 你属什么？
column6: Wǒ shǔ mǎ.
column7: I was born in the year of the horse.

column3: To belong to, for ownership or category: 属于我 "belongs to me", 属于动物 "belongs to animals". 属 "belong" + 于 "to". It can also mean "to be part of a type": 这属于什么类型？
column6: Zhè běn shū shǔyú wǒ.
column7: This book belongs to me.

column3: To combine and "combination": 颜色组合 "color combination", 组合在一起 "put together". 组 "form" + 合 "combine". It is also a name for a band or group.
column4: 这几个词可以组合成一句话。
column5: 這幾個詞可以組合成一句話。
column6: Zhè jǐ gè cí kěyǐ zǔhé chéng yī jù huà.
column7: These words can be put together into a sentence.

column3: To combine, integrate: 结合起来 "combine", 理论结合实践 "combine theory with practice". 结 "tie" + 合 "join". It joins two different things into one whole. In older texts it also means "to marry".
column4: 学习要和实践结合起来。
column5: 學習要和實踐結合起來。
column6: Xuéxí yào hé shíjiàn jiéhé qǐlái.
column7: Study needs to be combined with practice.

column3: To close, join, fit together: 合上书 "close the book", 合作 "cooperate", 合适 "suitable", 合理 "reasonable". On its own it's a verb for closing something that was open, like a book or an eye. It is mostly found in compounds.
column6: Qǐng bǎ shū hé shang.
column7: Please close the book.

column3: Target, object of an action or study: 研究对象 "research subject", 服务对象 "people served". In speech it also means a romantic partner: 找对象 "look for a partner", 谈对象 "be dating". 对 "facing" + 象 "image".
column6: Tā zài zhǎo duìxiàng.
column7: He is looking for a partner.

column3: Read diào here: "to transfer, to transfer a person": 调到北京 "be transferred to Beijing", 调查 "investigate", 声调 "tone", 调子 "tune". The reading tiáo (to adjust, tune) is the other main one. The reading follows the compound.
column6: Tā bèi diào dào le Běijīng.
column7: He was transferred to Beijing.

column3: To investigate, survey: 做调查 "do a survey", 调查结果 "survey results", 警察在调查 "the police are investigating". 调 here is diào. 调 "inquire" + 查 "check".
column6: Wǒmen zuò le yī gè diàochá.
column7: We did a survey.

column3: Evidence, proof: 有证据 "have evidence", 找到证据 "find evidence", 没有证据 "there is no evidence". 证 "prove" + 据 "basis". Used in law and arguments.
column6: Jǐngchá zhǎodào le xīn zhèngjù.
column7: The police found new evidence.

column3: To prove and "a certificate": 事实证明 "facts prove", 证明身份 "prove identity", 收入证明 "proof of income". 证 "prove" + 明 "clear". As a noun, an official document that proves something.
column6: Shìshí zhèngmíng tā shì duì de.
column7: The facts prove he was right.

column3: To sum up and "summary": 总结经验 "sum up the experience", 工作总结 "work summary". 总 "total" + 结 "tie up". Done at the end of a task or year, to draw lessons.
column4: 我们来总结一下今天的内容。
column5: 我們來總結一下今天的內容。
column6: Wǒmen lái zǒngjié yīxià jīntiān de nèiróng.
column7: Let's sum up today's content.

column3: To tidy up, sort out: 整理房间 "tidy the room", 整理资料 "organize materials". 整 "put in order" + 理 "manage". Covers both putting things in place and organizing notes or information.
column6: Wǒ zài zhěnglǐ fángjiān.
column7: I'm tidying up my room.

column3: To record, write down and "a record": 记录下来 "write it down", 会议记录 "meeting minutes". 记 "note" + 录 "record". For notes taken on paper or by device. Sports records use 纪录.
column4: 我把会议内容记录下来。
column5: 我把會議內容記錄下來。
column6: Wǒ bǎ huìyì nèiróng jìlù xiàlái.
column7: I wrote down the content of the meeting.

column3: A "record" in the sense of a best result: 打破纪录 "break a record", 世界纪录 "world record". It is the same sound as 记录 but written with 纪.
column6: Tā dǎpò le shìjiè jìlù.
column7: He broke the world record.

column3: To commemorate and "souvenir, memento": 纪念日 "anniversary", 纪念品 "souvenir", 有纪念意义 "of commemorative value". 纪 "record" + 念 "think of".
column4: 这张照片很有纪念意义。
column5: 這張照片很有紀念意義。
column6: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn hěn yǒu jìniàn yìyì.
column7: This photo has great sentimental value.

column3: A test, trial and "to put to the test": 经受考验 "stand the test", 考验耐心 "test one's patience". 考 "test" + 验 "check". It is a hard situation that shows someone's character, not an exam.
column4: 这次经历是对我的一次考验。
column5: 這次經歷是對我的一次考驗。
column6: Zhè cì jīnglì shì duì wǒ de yī cì kǎoyàn.
column7: This experience was a test for me.

column3: Experience gained by doing: 工作经验 "work experience", 有经验 "experienced", 经验丰富 "rich in experience". 经 "go through" + 验 "test". It is what you know from experience, while 经历 is what you lived through.
column6: Tā yǒu fēngfù de gōngzuò jīngyàn.
column7: He has a lot of work experience.

column3: To go through, experience and "experience, background": 经历过 "has been through", 人生经历 "life experience". 经 "pass through" + 历 "undergo". It is the events lived through, often hard ones.
column6: Tā jīnglì guo hěn duō shì.
column7: He has been through a lot.

column3: Effect, result: 效果好 "works well", 看到效果 "see results", 特殊效果 "special effects". 效 "effect" + 果 "result". It names how well something works.
column6: Zhè zhǒng yào de xiàoguǒ hěn hǎo.
column7: This medicine works very well.

column3: Consequences, usually bad: 严重的后果 "serious consequences", 后果很严重 "the consequences are serious". 后 "after" + 果 "result". It often appears in warnings.
column4: 这样做会有严重的后果。
column5: 這樣做會有嚴重的後果。
column6: Zhèyàng zuò huì yǒu yánzhòng de hòuguǒ.
column7: Doing this will have serious consequences.

column3: Process, course: 学习的过程 "the learning process", 在……的过程中 "in the course of…", 过程很长 "a long process". 过 "pass" + 程 "course". It is the steps that lead to a result, contrasted with 结果.
column4: 学习是一个长期的过程。
column5: 學習是一個長期的過程。
column6: Xuéxí shì yī gè chángqī de guòchéng.
column7: Learning is a long process.
